item.title: CVE-2026-133189 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 9.6
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 9.6 | A command injection vulnerability was found in OpenStack Cinder's SSH-based storage-driver support. Incomplete validation of shell metacharacters allows an authenticated user who owns a volume on an affected backend to supply crafted connection information and inject additional commands into the storage array's management interface. Commands execute with the privileges of Cinder's configured backend account. This can disclose storage configuration information and, where that account has administrative permissions, could allow changes that affect the integrity or availability of other tenants' storage.

item.title: CVE-2026-133200 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9 | A flaw was found in quarkus-vertx-utils. item.title: CVE-2026-133276 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | When extra data is allowed (extra=Extra.allow), providing a __pydantic_initialised__ key when validating a Pydantic V1 dataclass makes it considered as already validated, resulting in field values not being validated. The __init__() method of Pydantic V1 dataclasses stores all the provided keyword arguments in the instance __dict__ before validation, so a __pydantic_initialised__ keyword argument overrides the internal flag used to skip validation of already validated instances. As a result, data returned by validation doesn't match the declared type. Affected are applications validating untrusted data into Pydantic V1 dataclasses allowing extra data. The issue was fixed in Pydantic 1.10.27. Users relying on the pydantic.v1 namespace in Pydantic V2 should upgrade to 2.14.2 or later.

item.title: CVE-2026-59988 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.2
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.2 | django-docutils provides reStructuredText support for Django. Prior to 0.30.0, public rendering paths including publish_doctree, publish_html_from_source, publish_html_from_doctree, publish_parts_from_doctree, the {% rst %} template tag, the rst template filter, DocutilsTemplates, and DocutilsView pass lower-trust reStructuredText to Docutils without disabling file_insertion_enabled, raw_enabled, ambient docutils.conf processing, or unsafe URI schemes and without consistently sanitizing doctrees. An attacker who can influence rendered reStructuredText can use include or csv-table directives to read local files or cause server-side URL requests, or use raw HTML and unsafe URI output to inject stored script-capable content. Applications that render only trusted static reStructuredText are not affected unless attackers can influence it. This issue is fixed in version 0.30.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-69260 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.6
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.6 | Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. From 0.5.0 until 3.8.1, Git LFS does not format the SSH URL path component as a single argument when constructing remote object-transfer or authentication commands. Shell metacharacters in the SSH URL can therefore escape the intended path argument and cause arbitrary command execution when the remote Git LFS service passes received commands to a shell without adequate sanitization. Git LFS also incorrectly encodes default HTTPS URLs when an SSH URL is configured and the remote host either does not support Git LFS remote commands over SSH or supports HTTP authentication over SSH but git-lfs-authenticate does not return an explicit HTTP URL. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.1.

item.title: CVE-2026-69261 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.6
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.6 | Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. From 0.5.0 until 3.8.1, Git LFS may forward a Cookie header after an HTTP redirect to a host other than the one for which the header was intended. That unintended host can therefore receive cookies containing credentials or other confidential values. Authorization headers are never forwarded to inappropriate hosts and are not the affected secret in this vulnerability. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.1.

item.title: CVE-2026-77318 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | Jupyter MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol server for Jupyter. Prior to 1.0.3, standalone streamable-http mode can enforce MCP_TOKEN on /mcp while leaving the state-changing /api/connect and /api/stop management routes unauthenticated. An unauthenticated network caller can use /api/connect to replace runtime_url and document_url values and their tokens, reset ServerContext, and start a kernel client against attacker-controlled infrastructure, causing the server to send Jupyter API and WebSocket traffic to that backend. The caller can also use /api/stop to stop the current notebook kernel. This boundary failure does not require explicit insecure no-auth mode and occurs outside normal MCP JSON-RPC tool dispatch. This issue is fixed in version 1.0.3.

item.title: CVE-2026-77336 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | Aperi'Solve is an open-source steganalysis web platform. Prior to 3.4.2, an unauthenticated user can submit a PNG to POST /upload, which reaches aperisolve/utils/png.py through analyze_image, PCRTAnalyzer, PNG.repair(), and check_idat(). A malformed IDAT chunk can make attacker-controlled length and newline data drive an unbounded combinations search in PNG._fix_dos2unix(), causing repeated CRC checks that occupy a worker and delay or block image analysis for other users. Per-IP upload limits and eventual job termination bound the denial of service, and the issue has no confidentiality or integrity impact. This issue is fixed in version 3.4.2.

item.title: CVE-2026-77338 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | Sprout Track is a self-hosted baby tracking application. Prior to 1.3.5, Sprout Track uses a publicly known hardcoded signing secret when JWT_SECRET is unset, and standard setup does not generate a unique secret. On a network-reachable affected deployment, an unauthenticated attacker can sign JWTs with arbitrary claims, including system-administrator claims, to access administrative functionality and read or modify family, child activity, account, and email data. Deployments with a strong unique JWT_SECRET are not affected. Managed and hosted instances were reported remediated. This issue is fixed in version 1.3.5.

item.title: CVE-2026-77359 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | Jupyter MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol server for Jupyter. Prior to 1.0.3, standalone streamable-http mode validates Host and Origin values for /mcp but does not apply the same browser-origin controls to the state-changing /api/connect and /api/stop management routes. A malicious website can use DNS rebinding so that its hostname resolves to a loopback, LAN, VPN, or published-container MCP listener, then send a browser-shaped request that /api/connect accepts to replace runtime_url and document_url values and start a kernel client against attacker-controlled infrastructure. The attacker can thereby cause Jupyter API and WebSocket traffic to reach that infrastructure and can use /api/stop to stop the current notebook kernel. The default broad bind can increase exposure, but the vulnerability is the missing management-route origin boundary, not a lack of Host validation on /mcp. This issue is fixed in version 1.0.3.

item.title: CVE-2026-77367 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 9.4
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 9.4 | Daptin is a GraphQL/JSON-API headless CMS. Prior to 0.12.30, the generic GET /api/{entity} list endpoint accepts attacker-controlled sort values in PaginatedFindAllWithoutFilters in server/resource/resource_findallpaginated.go without validating the requested column against the table schema. The code uses those values for SELECT and ORDER BY identifier construction, so an embedded identifier quote can terminate the quoted identifier and make the remainder parse as SQL, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to extract unauthorized table data through blind or error-based behavior or repeatedly trigger query failures. This issue is fixed in version 0.12.30.

item.title: CVE-2026-77369 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 9.6
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 9.6 | Daptin is a GraphQL/JSON-API headless CMS. From 0.11.4 until 0.12.30, the generic GET /yjs/:documentName WebSocket route in InitializeYjsResources requires a session but does not authorize the database resource selected by a typename.referenceId.columnName room name. The YJS initial-content provider then reads the selected file.* column without CanRead or CanUpdate checks, and bidirectional synchronization allows a low-privileged authenticated user to read or modify restricted row content. Unauthenticated requests are rejected, and standalone non-canonical room names remain shared-by-name rooms. This issue is fixed in version 0.12.30.

item.title: CVE-2026-77382 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9 | falcon-rust is a Rust implementation of the Falcon post-quantum signature scheme. Prior to 0.2.0, the discrete-Gaussian sampler in src/samplerz.rs evaluates approx_exp, ber_exp, and sampler_z acceptance probabilities with FixedPoint64 values having only 32 fractional bits. The scaling in approx_exp quantizes its input and limits relative precision to about 2^-33, below Falcon's required bound, causing reference known-answer vectors to diverge and invalidating the proof assumption that secret-dependent signature and key distributions are negligibly close to the ideal discrete Gaussian. This is a cryptographic-soundness defect and no practical key-recovery attack has been demonstrated. This issue is fixed in version 0.2.0.
